final: WITH player_counts AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY a.player_id, p.bats), hand_totals AS (SELECT bats, SUM(award_count) AS hand_total FROM player_counts GROUP BY bats), shares AS (SELECT pc.player_id, pc.bats, pc.award_count, CAST(pc.award_count AS REAL) / ht.hand_total AS share FROM player_counts AS pc JOIN hand_totals AS ht ON pc.bats COLLATE BINARY = ht.bats COLLATE BINARY), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT s.player_id, s.bats, s.award_count, s.share, s.share - o.average_share AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN overall AS o ON o.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > o.average_share ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
